line: Six of Cups: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title, sign and the Sun's influence, as the chapter gives them (pdf 178, 203).

quotes.quote: The Six of Cups is called Pleasure.
The zodiacal sign governing the card being Scorpio
influence is fortified by that of the Sun, who also represents the Six

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The Sixes belong to Tiphareth (pdf 177), and Tiphareth is the Sun in the planetary system (pdf 177).

quotes.quote: These cards are attributed to Tiphareth.
In the planetary system it represents the Sun;

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: Crowley's own gloss on the title, not a divinatory reading.

quotes.quote: Pleasure, in the title of this card, must be understood in its highest sense
